content: भद्र {%a.%} [भन्द्-रक् नि˚ नलोपः <ls>Uṇ. 2. 28</ls>] .²1 Good, happy, prosperous. .²2 Auspicious, blessed; as in भद्रमुख. .²3 Foremost, best, chief; पप्रच्छ भद्रं विजितारिभद्रः <ls>R. 14. 31</ls>. .²4 Favourable, propitious; भद्रं कर्णेभिः शृणुयाम देवा भद्रं पश्येमाक्षभिर्यजत्राः <ls>Rv. 1. 89. 8</ls>. .²5 Kind, gracious, excellent, friendly, good; often used in <ab>voc.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> in the sense of ‘my good sir’, or ‘my good friend’, ‘my good lady’, ‘my dear madam’. .²6 Pleasant, enjoyable, lovely, beautiful; न तु कृच्छ्रादपि भद्रं निजकान्तं सा भजत्येव <ls>Pt. 1. 181</ls>. .²7 Laudable, desirable, praiseworthy. .²8 Beloved, dear. .²9 Specious, plausible, hypocritical. .²10 Skilful, expert; भद्रोऽस्मि नृत्ये कुशलोऽस्मि गीते <ls>Mb. 4. 11. 8</ls>. .{@-द्रम्@} .²1 Happiness, good fortune, welfare, blessing, prosperity; भद्रं भद्रं वितर भगवन् भूयसे मङ्गलाय <ls>Māl. 1. 3</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">6. 7</ls>; त्वयि वितरतु भद्रं भूयसे मङ्गलाय <ls>U. 3. 48</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> used in <ab>pl.</ab> in this sense; सर्वो भद्राणि पश्यतु; भद्रं ते ‘god bless you’, ‘prosperity to you’. .²2 Gold. .²3 A fragrant grass. .²4 Iron, steel. .²5 The seventh Karaṇa. {@द्रः@} .²1 A bullock. .²2 A species of wag-tail. .²3 A term applied to a particular kind of elephants. .²4 An impostor, a hypocrite; <ls>Ms. 9. 258</ls>. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²6 An epithet of mount Meru. .²7 The Devadāru tree. .²8 A kind of {%Kadamba%}. (भद्राकृ means ‘to shave’; भद्राकरणम् shaving).
